2610.13823.title: Same Query, Different Answer: Run-to-Run Variance in Semantic Query Processing
2610.13823.paper_summary: Semantic query engines ask a large language model (LLM) to judge individual rows, and benchmarks compare these engines on the quality of a few executions at temperature 0. We measure how much another execution changes. We re-execute the text and tabular workloads of SemBench, LRO-Bench, and UDA-Bench through their own harnesses, log every one of 1.2 million model calls, and reanalyze SemBench's published executions. At temperature 0, between 0.07% and 10.2% of rows change their operator output over five executions, depending on the model, and up to 24.0% on one task. Plans amplify these changes exponentially in the number of rows an answer exposes, as a possible-worlds model predicts: on UDA-Bench, a few percent of extracted values change, but about two thirds of the answers do. In SemBench's published results, 21% of text results change quality between executions, including on engines whose plans are deterministic. Several per-query system comparisons, and 16 of 28 tests of LRO-Bench's implementation recommendations, are not settled by the executions the benchmarks run. Changing rows are rows on which models disagree with each other; identical requests within one execution disagree as often as across executions; and one execution's decision margin or reasoning length predicts which rows change. Voting reduces the variance but does not remove it, and a calibrated cascade keeps its guarantee while the rows it returns change. We derive reporting rules for benchmarks and design rules for engines.
2610.13823.paper_summary_zh: 語意查詢引擎要求大型語言模型（LLM）對個別行進行評判，而基準測試則比較這些引擎在溫度為0時的幾次執行的質量。我們測量另一個執行的變化程度。我們通過它們自己的框架重新執行SemBench、LRO-Bench和UDA-Bench的文本和表格工作負載，記錄每一個120萬次模型調用，並重新分析SemBench發佈的執行結果。在溫度為0的情況下，根據模型的不同，0.07%到10.2%的行在五次執行中改變了其運算符輸出，而在一個任務中則高達24.0%。計劃在答案暴露的行數上指數放大這些變化，正如可能世界模型所預測的：在UDA-Bench上，幾個百分比的提取值發生變化，但大約三分之二的答案則發生變化。在SemBench發佈的結果中，21%的文本結果在執行之間改變了質量，包括在那些計劃是確定性的引擎上。幾個每查詢系統的比較，以及LRO-Bench實施建議的28個測試中的16個，並未被基準測試執行所解決。改變的行是模型之間意見不一致的行；在一次執行中的相同請求之間的分歧頻率與跨執行的分歧頻率一樣高；而一次執行的決策邊際或推理長度預測哪些行會改變。投票減少了變異性，但並未消除它，而經過校準的級聯在返回的行發生變化時仍保持其保證。我們為基準測試制定報告規則，並為引擎設計規則。
2610.13823.author: Oktie Hassanzadeh et.al.
